request.story_prompt:
Maya is a young girl who enters a mysterious forest alone. Deep inside the forest, she discovers an old Game Machine near a huge tree.
Curious, Maya touches the machine.
Suddenly—
“GAME START!” 🎮
The forest gates close, and Maya becomes trapped inside the game.
🔴 Level 1 – Forest Run
Maya must run through the dark forest while a terrifying shadow chases her. She avoids dangerous obstacles and successfully completes Level 1.
🟠 Level 2 – Mystery House
Maya enters an abandoned house filled with mysterious puzzles. She must solve the puzzles and find the correct exit before the game resets.
Using her intelligence, Maya completes Level 2.
🟢 Level 3 – Final Choice
Maya reaches the final room. On a table, she finds two cards:
1️⃣ LOSE
2️⃣ WIN
A mysterious voice says:
“Choose only one card…”
Maya takes a deep breath and chooses the WIN card.
Suddenly—
💥 GAME COMPLETED! 💥
The door opens, and Maya escapes from the forest.
Outside, she discovers the game's grand prize: bags of money, gold, and treasure. 💰💎

panels.title: The Discovery
panels.scene_description: Alex, a young girl with messy hair and a backpack, stands before a massive, ancient tree in the enchanted forest. She discovers a glowing, vintage arcade machine embedded in the tree's roots.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, medium shot of a young girl named Alex with shoulder-length brown hair and a denim jacket, standing in a magical forest with glowing bioluminescent plants, looking at a retro arcade machine built into an ancient oak tree, vibrant colors, dramatic lighting.

panels.title: Game Start
panels.scene_description: Alex touches the screen. Bright neon text 'GAME START!' flashes, and magical vines slam shut the forest entrance, trapping her inside a digital-looking barrier.
panels.image_prompt: Close up of Alex's hand touching a cracked arcade screen, neon green digital energy ripples out, the background forest is turning into glitchy pixelated vines, intense action, high contrast, comic book art style.

panels.title: Forest Run
panels.scene_description: Alex is sprinting through the dark woods, dodging glowing red obstacles while a towering, amorphous shadow creature chases her from behind.
panels.image_prompt: Action shot, Alex running fast through a dark enchanted forest, motion blur, a giant terrifying ink-black shadow monster looms behind her, glowing red hazardous roots on the ground, dynamic perspective, comic book style.

panels.title: The Final Choice
panels.scene_description: Inside a floating room, Alex stands before a table with two glowing cards. She reaches out with a determined expression to grab the 'WIN' card.
panels.image_prompt: Medium shot, Alex in a surreal floating room with checkered floors, two glowing holographic cards floating above a stone pedestal, one says 'LOSE' in red, one says 'WIN' in gold, Alex's hand is reaching for the gold card, intense focus, comic book art.

panels.title: The Grand Prize
panels.scene_description: The forest gates burst open. Alex stands outside, safe, surrounded by piles of gold coins and treasure chests that appeared from the game.
panels.image_prompt: Wide shot, Alex standing at the edge of the enchanted forest, bright sunlight, massive piles of gold coins, sparkling jewels, and open treasure chests scattered around her, a sense of victory, comic book style, vibrant colors.
